title: Towards Diverse and Comprehensive Benchmarks for Mutual Information Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2607.03487v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mutual information estimation is a central problem in machine learning and statistics; however, existing benchmarks typically evaluate estimators on simplified, low-dimensional distributions, leaving their performance on complex, realistic data largely unexplored. We address this gap with a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective that subsumes existing benchmarks as special cases. Within this framework, we propose two complementary families of tests: a copula-first family that systematically varies ground-truth mutual information, dimensionality, and marginal complexity using synthetic and flow-based transformations; and a marginals-first family that couples real-world image data with controlled dependency structures, extending the classic same-class-pairing paradigm. We use this suite to extensively evaluate three classes of estimators: non-parametric, variational, and generative. Cont

translated_title: 迈向多样化且全面的互信息估计基准
translated_abstract: 互信息估计是机器学习和统计学中的核心问题；然而，现有基准通常仅在简化的低维分布上评估估计器，其在复杂、真实数据上的性能在很大程度上尚未被探索。我们通过一个基于统一Copula理论视角的全面基准测试框架来填补这一空白，该框架将现有基准作为特例包含在内。在该框架内，我们提出了两个互补的测试族：一是“Copula优先”族，利用合成数据和基于流的变换系统地改变真实互信息、维度和边缘复杂度；二是“边缘优先”族，将真实世界的图像数据与受控的依赖结构相结合，扩展了经典的同类配对范式。我们使用该套件对三类估计器——非参数、变分和生成式——进行了广泛评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于统一Copula理论的互信息估计综合基准框架，通过“Copula优先”和“边缘优先”两个互补测试族，系统评估了非参数、变分和生成式三类估计器在复杂真实数据上的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a comprehensive benchmarking framework for mutual information estimation grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective, featuring two complementary test families that systematically evaluate non-parametric, variational, and generative estimators on complex, realistic data.
